title: An online order
intro: What happens between a shopper pressing Pay and the warehouse packing the box. Press Play, or step through it.

shopper.label: Shopper
shopper.info: A customer with a full basket, about to press Pay.

mailer.label: Email service
mailer.info: An outside company that sends emails for the shop.

shop.label: Shop server
shop.info: The program behind the website. It is the only part that talks to the others.

payments.label: Payment provider
payments.info: An outside company that charges the card. The shop never stores the card number.

orders.label: Orders table
orders.info: The shop's own record of every order.

warehouse.label: Warehouse screen
warehouse.info: The list the packers work from.

steps.text: The shopper presses Pay. The basket and the delivery address go to the shop.
The shop sends the card payment to the payment provider.
steps.ifNot: the provider declines the card. The shopper sees "payment failed" and nothing is saved.

steps.text: The provider answers that the payment went through.
The shop saves the order as paid.
The order appears on the warehouse pick list.
The shop asks the email service to send a receipt.
The shopper gets the receipt by email.
